scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 Q8_0 no-bias dense-linear selector policy gate after SLM-CPU-189
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-190 defines selector policy only; it does not implement, select, or enable a no-bias dense-linear fast path.
Future runtime selection must be role-specific and fail closed for any role with missing, unknown, contradictory, or bias_present=true manifest evidence.
Qwen2.5 attention q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj are explicitly blocked because bias_present=true.
No allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5 runtime support, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 behavior is claimed.

summary.blanket_no_bias_selector_blocker: Qwen2.5 attention q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj have bias_present=true.

recommended_next_item.recommended_action: If implementing code next, add only a runtime-disabled selector contract that reads a manifest identity and refuses biased roles by default; require paired before/after receipts before any runtime execution path is enabled.

must_not_claim: A no-bias dense-linear fast path is implemented or selected by default.
Runtime selection or generated output behavior changed.
Allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, broad decode latency, prefill latency, model-load latency, or warm-session end-to-end speedup is proven.
Q4_K_M or Q4_K_S runtime support exists.
Server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, or UHD 620 execution is involved.
Qwen3.5 or hybrid architecture support is in scope.
